choices: Drives: ens_outlier_v2 string == 'False' (blank/True excluded); raw matched by digits; calendar day = master date. Time HH:MM:SS.fff, midnight unwrapped on cumulative backward jumps >12 h over file rows. Current: non-NaN, |I|<900, sorted, duplicate times dropped (first kept). V 200-450 np.interp (edge clamped). SoC>0; primary applies glitch removal (drop sample jumping >=20 pp from last kept sample if a sample within 5 s returns to <20 pp of last kept value). Segments: gaps >10 s, >20 samples. B: SoC samples with time in [seg start, seg end], >=10; event = consecutive SoC pair differing by 0.5 (tol 1e-6, either sign); >=3 events/seg; segment demeaned; pooled OLS no intercept; trapezoid. Reverse: level~a*Q+b*th, 100/a. A: segments >=10 min and >=10 SoC samples; medians of first/last 5 SoC. Windows: SoC restricted to span covered by I and V, strictly increasing times; failed window advances a by one sample, successful advances to b; SoC jump >2 pp check on all consecutive pairs in window (all <=5 s after gap check); current-gap check on current samples bracketing [t_a,t_b]; re-anchor needs k>=1 with sign(s[k]-s[k-1])==d. Bootstrap: resample calendar days with replacement, default_rng(42), 4000 draws, percentile 2.5/97.5, refit from per-day sufficient statistics.
